A '''planet''' was the homeworld of a [[Unidentified purple-skinned humanoid species|purple-skinned humanoid race]]. [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and an unnamed [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] traveled to the planet, where the purple-skinned humanoid natives practiced the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] religion.
